sources.note: Main homepage. Product suite overview (MedicsCloud EHR, MedicsPremier, MedicsRIS, MedicsScribeAI, ADSRCM). Named customers. Claims thousands of healthcare organizations, 50M EDI transactions annually.
Founded 1977 by David Barzillai. 300+ employees, privately owned, debt-free, never acquired/merged. All development in-house. 15,000 sq ft HQ in Paramus, NJ.
Timeline from 1977 MEDICS I through 2020. MedicsDocAssistant beta 1996, full production 2000. 2,500+ clients by 2007. Cloud implementations began 2010. Tens of thousands of users by 2019.

ONC mandatory disclosures for MedicsDocAssistant v8.0. 52 criteria, 25 CQMs. Integrates Newcrop for eRx, Surescripts N2N Direct Messaging, Meinberg NTP. Cost structure: licensing + per-user + third-party modules.
Two separately certified products: MedicsDocAssistant v8.0 and MedicsCloud EHR v11.0. Both ambulatory EHRs. Real-world testing materials for 2022-2025.
MedicsCloud v11.0 mandatory disclosures. 56 criteria (vs 52 for MedicsDocAssistant). Uses Surescripts directly for eRx (not Newcrop). Separately certified product.
EHR product page. AI features (ScribeAI, HCC Coding, Fax Automapping, Synopsis), remote patient monitoring, telemedicine, kiosk, specialty templates, MIPS dashboard. Cloud-hosted on Equinix.

Detailed EHR features: CPOE (meds, labs, imaging), evidence-based medicine blue ribbons, MedicsRx e-prescribing, MedicsPortal patient portal, Medics On-Call mobile, FlowText voice/handwriting, encounter-based documentation, role-based security.
Additional EHR features page with similar content to ehr-all-features.

MedicsPremier PM features: multi-modality scheduler, SMS reminders, claims processing (HCFA/UB/WorkersComp/NoFault), eligibility checks, denial risk alerts, patient responsibility estimator, CRM, inventory tracking, KPI dashboards.
All-in-One Suite page. EHR + PM unified platform, no redundant data entry, claims from clinical encounters, shared scheduling/documentation/billing/reporting.
MedicsRIS: radiology-specific system. Multi-modality workflow, mammography tracking with biopsy results, PACS integration, referring physician portal, patient portal.

AI product suite: MedicsScribeAI (voice-to-text), AI Rules Engine (billing automation), HCC Coding AI, Bill Code Analyzer, AI Synopsis, Consult Letter Generator, MedicsAI Fax (document categorization and routing).
ADSRCM outsourced billing service. 300+ billing professionals. 3-6% of collections pricing. Can interface with any EHR.

Behavioral health specialty page. ASAM assessments flowing into patient timelines and auto-generating problem lists/treatment plans. Supports outpatient, MAT, IOP, PHP, residential, detox, group therapy. Dual diagnosis tracking. BedManager for facility operations.
Lists 28+ specialties with dedicated product configurations.
Hosted on Equinix. Hyper-V cluster with replication. Veeam backup, 30-day recovery points. SOC 1 and SOC 2 certified.
SOC 1/2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53/FISMA, PCI DSS compliance. 99.9999% uptime claim.
Medics Me app for patient-mediated exchange via OAuth 2. References information blocking provisions.
Press release describing product tiers: MedicsRX (standalone eRx), MedicsDocAssistantOffice (entry-level tablet EHR), MedicsDocAssistant (full EHR). Graduated upgrade path.
EHI export page for (b)(10). Supports single patient and population-level export in CCDA XML (USCDI v1) and FHIR v4.0.1 US Core v3.1.1. Does not specify data fields or tables included.

3.6/5 stars (11 reviews). Product listed as MedicsCloud EHR (formerly MedicsDocAssistant EHR). Users praise Patient Timeline, Exit Plan features, confirmation texts, customer support. Criticize Home Screen inconsistencies, initial bugs.

5/5 stars (4 reviews). Users from internal medicine, behavioral health, family medicine. Praise ease of use, ROI, multi-modality scheduling. Features: specialty templates, eRx, automated lab orders, electronic superbills, voice recognition, patient portal. Pricing ~$300/mo per provider.
4/5 stars (2 reviews). MedicsPremier PM reviews. Praise user-friendly interface, patient history module. Criticize software lag/crashes, medication list limitations.

3.7/5 stars (23 reviews). 65% positive, 26% neutral, 9% negative. Specialties confirmed: general practice, pediatrics, OB/GYN, cardiology, orthopedics, family medicine, neurology, psychiatry, oncology, dermatology, endocrinology.
32 reviews (50% excellent, 45% good). Users praise smooth navigation, billing integration, reporting. 'Caters to over 30 specialties.' Reviews from practices with 2-49 staff.

Press releases 2013-2025. Notable: FL Bureau of Public Health Labs selects MedicsPremier (2020), DON Recovery Services selects MedicsCloud (2019), clinical trials support (2015), BedManager for addiction facilities (2014), Medical Economics #21 ranking (2013), AI tools launched (2024-2025).
Top Medical Practice Management Software Solution Company 2016. Describes ADS as serving thousands of medical practices with 30+ years experience.
